Scenario facts: The plan costs GBP 24 monthly. June's bill is GBP 30, including a single GBP 6 roaming charge. The roaming charge is not recurring.
My June bill is GBP 30 instead of GBP 24. Why?
It includes your GBP 24 plan plus a one-off GBP 6 roaming charge.
Will that extra charge appear every month?
No. This GBP 6 charge is one-off; your regular plan remains GBP 24 monthly.

Scenario facts: To explain how to dispute a charge, first ask its date, then direct the user to Support > Billing > Dispute and to include the date and amount. France roaming is included; enable it under Settings > Mobile > Data roaming. Giving directions does not open a dispute.
I want you to explain how to dispute a GBP 6 charge. Once I give you its date, please finish those instructions even if I ask another question.
What date was that GBP 6 charge? I need it to give you the dispute instructions.
One quick thing before that: is France roaming included?
Yes, France roaming is included. We can return to the dispute instructions afterwards.
The charge was on 12 June. Also, how do I enable roaming in France?

Enable France roaming under Settings > Mobile > Data roaming. For the earlier dispute request, go to Support > Billing > Dispute and include 12 June and GBP 6. These are instructions; no dispute has been opened yet.
Thanks.
You are welcome.

Scenario facts: The first reset method is the sign-in page's reset-link option. If repeated delivery attempts fail, use Support > Account access > Verified support chat for identity verification. This assistant cannot reset a password or send an email itself.
I need to reset my password. Where do I start?
Use the reset-link option on the sign-in page to request an email.
I tried that but did not receive the email.
Check spam and confirm the address you entered. You can retry the reset-link request once.
I checked spam, confirmed the address, and retried. Still nothing. What else can I do?
Since delivery is still failing, use Support > Account access > Verified support chat for identity verification and another recovery route. I cannot reset the password here.
